items.title: Universal Braille & Tactile STEM Learning Kits
items.content_html: Funding open-source 3D-printable tactile science and math models for low-vision and blind students worldwide.

_polytab.summary: Funding open-source 3D-printable tactile science and math models for low-vision and blind students worldwide.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Blind students lack touchable math and science models.

Proof: Open hardware files and school delivery receipts.

items.title: Direct Mobile Cash Transfers to Rural Households
items.content_html: Delivering unconditional micro-grants directly to extreme-poverty female heads of household via M-Pesa mobile money.

_polytab.summary: Delivering unconditional micro-grants directly to extreme-poverty female heads of household via M-Pesa mobile money.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Extreme poverty with zero access to traditional banks.

Proof: Public transaction batch dashboard.
